notes.content:
The RPG Maker Festival is going on until February 10th. And it is a great time to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025]highlight developers[/url] using the engine. We have deployed a new set of updates for the event.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2384221/ss_cb26bf19b847980ec59ea3a7f96f1f40f8da254c.1920x1080.jpg?t=1734126020[/img]

Horizons updates:
Increased the danger of the encounters around the Werminn Frontier Encampment (through the world gate, north of Winterholme). These encounters, particularly the bosses, should give the player a better idea of what to expect on harder difficulty* and speed up the leveling process as well. This is the only part of the update that applies to the base demo.

Added a conversation with Neve that takes place at one of the farms inside the Royal Empire. Must complete Neve's initial quest and her conversation at one of the Frostwind farms beforehand.

Added an exclusive item for Neve to equip.

Greatly increased the difficulty to the boss encounter in the rogue mages lair south of the Mages Academy. The reason for this is that the initial encounter was kind of a throwaway and felt underwhelming.

Also, because they are yqynqde ar ftq efgpqzf oagzoux,** they have to be stronger than God by anime logic.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2384140/discussions/]discussion board[/url]. There's even a leveling guide there for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure and Horizons. It's probably the best point of contact. 

A good chunk of the rebalancing was due to playing games from other devs that improved their own works as well as listening to what other people liked about their favorite games. All too often, I think critics miss that point. Making fun games inspires others to improve their own projects.

We hope you enjoy the game and have a great day.

notes.title: Luminous Skies: December Update
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2384221/ss_0db621bd9d81c8a9928102de43bbca416128b95d.1920x1080.jpg?t=1732556650[/img]

Made adjustments for weapon damage types for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure, Horizons, The Pilgrimage, and Interstellar.

Physical damage now represents blunt force damage. Batons, maces, staves, and fists fall under this category.

Slashing damage covers: swords [wooden ones too], daggers, and axes.

Penetration damage covers: spears, bows, crossbows, and firearms.

The effect of this is less than when an enemy is weak to a specific element. The reasoning for this is that damage dealing characters and their skills were balanced not to have excessive additional damage from vulnerabilities such as these, as opposed to elemental damage.  For example, the Guardian / Vanguard / Defender can one shot a grunt on harder difficulty with a critical hit, especially if the enemy target has been debuffed.

But it does, nonetheless, give some additional texture to the game. Armored targets are vulnerable to penetration damage. Most people and creatures are vulnerable to slashing damage. The rest are vulnerable to blunt physical damage. For example, in Interstellar, switching to a gun will do more damage to robots and switching to a slashing weapon [shiv, chainsaw, and energy dagger] will do more damage to fleshy targets. notes.content:
I thought I was done making major zones to explore for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure and Horizons but they dragged me back in...

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2483256482313999864/2FF5700E498CB46DAC19AA920326ED4FE63082E4/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

You heard that right. A new exploration zone with 5 dungeons to explore has been made available to everyone, even if you haven't paid for anything. This zone can be accessed through a newly accessible world gate just north of Winterholme. The player will get to explore an area affecting by the aftermath of the events in Luminous Skies: The Unveiled Shroud, which is my submission for Pirate Software's 15th game jam. This takes place after those events, so there will be spoilers if you go in there before playing The Unveiled Shroud.

The primary function of these areas has been repurposed to give the player more easier zones to explore before tackling areas rated at the Harder difficulty level [rec. lvl. 55+]. This is largely due to the fact that there was a severe gap in difficulty between the intermediate and harder dungeons.

Additionally, random loot drops have been added to these new areas. This includes players for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure [though it should be noted that the loot selection is limited compared to players with Horizons installed as there are more weapon types available to use and more variety for paid users].

New quests Luminous Skies: Horizons
"Way of the Warrior" starts in Kazuko Temple and is only available if they have completed the quest "An Eye for an Eye" and the follow-up training session at the Frostwind campsite.

"Path of Wisdom" starts in the Town of Dawa's Inn and it is only available after completing the quest "Summoning Lair" which is part of a multipart quest regarding the Mages Academy.

A conversation should open up at ??? [it's a surprise], if the player has befriended Milla.

notes.title: Luminous Skies: Horizons Major Update
notes.content:
We have a major update in store for you this round of patches for Luminous Skies: Horizons [links below].

I'll start with some of the smaller things first:

The difficulty has been increased to several of the enemies on harder difficulties. This was an oversight as these enemies were under powered when compared to some of their counterparts. Some of the larger enemies now have a 20% of wounding their target with a regular attack. We hope that you enjoy the increased challenge.

Added the skill "Energy Strikes" to Nori's skill list.

I've added and updated three accessory items in the game to be character specific. I will elaborate on one that has been in the game for some time [I don't want to tell you about all of them; exploration and finding these things for yourself is part of the fun, after all].

After defeating the Mad Alchemist, the player can return to Oakside and enter into the Temple there. Once inside, there should be a glimmering icon that you can interact with.

notes.title: Luminous Skies: Horizons Major Update
notes.content:
After much effort on our part, the new update for Luminous Skies: Horizons is here.

The mainland is now open to explore in Horizons. All previous zones should be available to play and explore.

We have not 1, not 2, not 3, but 5 recruitable companions. That's right, we went overboard this update.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_39e5b667ee9b041e8822f75b75fadc25894cff49.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711065179[/img]

Lina who can be recruited after completing the Mender's Inn Quest that can be started by finding the marker in the shop at the Capitol City.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_cb26bf19b847980ec59ea3a7f96f1f40f8da254c.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711056951[/img]

Lapo and Maylis can be picked up at the Inn at Frostwind.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_4666149cc4337068f7f2283ca105623abc4052f6.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711065179[/img]

Neve can be recruited by starting the Quest Werminn Hunters, which can be found at the shop in Frostwind.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_210822a52d1d28228ae09212d471c2f96777aa89.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711056951[/img]

To get the Irida the Bard, there is a missing persons notice found on the Inn at the south east town of Thorn Creek and she can be picked up mid quest.

Completing the Mages Academy questline will open up another recruitable character.


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_b74b47be62d6419dd59a8dce4b771f0bbf261ec8.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711056951[/img]

There is a crafting mini game to forge pieces of dragon armor. As long as the player has enough scales, they will be able to forge them without having to pay the cost but it is possible to mess up, so the player will have to be careful.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_a52f8b8f147150a8d36b23c92410104d3ac27c29.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711056951[/img]

The swarm blaster mini game can be found in an encampment in the Eastern Frontier, to the west of Clear Lake.

There are almost a dozen new quests to pick up.

[b]We have an additional announcement:[/b]

Since before the launch of Luminous Skies, I've been at work on another standalone DLC. It is a Sci-Fi RPG called Luminous Skies: Interstellar. The price will be $11.99 and we plan to bundle with the other DLCs for the price of $19.99. If you have already purchased the other DLCs, we have you covered as the Interstellar DLC will be frequently on sale.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2840850/ss_7848943a4cf54df46c081bf93226b9aad4fe11da.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711063095[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2840850/ss_f50630394f78fed708f3c95f7e408348b84a766e.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711063095[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2840850/ss_362974acc529c9c84f178b7ffc68050e3242d3ea.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711063095[/img]

If you're uncertain about picking up Interstellar, there's a standalone mini campaign in Luminous Skies: Horizons. Visit the Commonwealth Facility on the northern end of the Shorehaven Isle. There's a training facility to test your strength and there's four more companions to recruit, making the total 9 and not 5 as advertised. Recruiting all four will allow you to board the shuttle in the living space basement and take it to a contested planet and become at least briefly familiarized with the various factions in Interstellar. The Cargo Claimer mini game has been added to Luminous Skies: Horizons [originally seen in the Pilgrimage DLC].

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_a20416e4096f5d6b31fed0eeac840f0e016b282a.1920x1080.jpg?t=1711056951[/img]

We hope you have been enjoying the game and have a great day.

notes.title: Luminous Skies: February 2024 updates
notes.content:
Earlier this year Valve announced they would allow the use A.I. generated content in software published on their platform.

With that in mind, I will NOT be pursuing the use of A.I. in my games. 

At best, the technology is still in its early stages, containing various legal and ethical issues along with it. More importantly, I feel like it would stunt my growth as a developer.

On to the updates:

Improved map files for the secret forest map [LS:P]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2272696714949609468/A90FF22176FB53B9A57048F4EC17C7AC8D1708BB/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

In order to move forward, we have implemented the updated journal system into A Short Adventure and Horizons [originally kept in there as a museum piece more than anything]. It can be found in Citra's basement along with the other diagnostic options [LS:ASA, LS:H].

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_56a46905f189beb2a32a9eacbdb96bf46c2334df.1920x1080.jpg?t=1706309911[/img]

Added Cass as a recruitable character to Horizons. She's based on a prototype of one of my characters. After realizing she was radically different person from what she became, I realized there was some extra story potential there. She can be found at the Shorehaven Port. [LS:H]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_cded7774cdbcb6951337bf9f815e8ea33630fe98.1920x1080.jpg?t=1706309911[/img]

Re-branded the paid DLC for A Short Adventure to Luminous Skies: Horizons [abbreviated LS:H]

Fixed error when initially loading both Maple and Ives Briar that prevented their full names from showing up in Horizons. [LS:H]

Why the re-brand? 

I had always planned on making a direct sequel to events found in the Pilgrimage. After reviewing things, I found it would be more efficient to add it onto the existing DLC.

Will there be any changes that I should be concerned about?

Yes and no. The price will eventually be raised to $4.99 USD [or the equivalent price based on your region]. While it is a significant increase, it is far less than the original projected price. If you've already purchased Horizons, you'll have all the content. If you've missed out on the discounted price, worry not, it will be on discount again. Please note that some of the encounters, in the new areas, may be subject to change as the story unfolds and updates are rolled out.


We hope you are enjoying the game and have a great day.

Initially, being able to select to have both the Male and Female Briar in the party was a test feature that I left in the DLC version of the game. Each character can swap between two classes [Ives: Spellsword and Shepherd] [Maple: Spellsword and Druid].

notes.title: Luminous Skies October 2023 Highlights and Update
notes.content:

Citra has been added as a playable companion for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure DLC.

And with that, the Bard class has been added to the game.

If you have fought the Forest Witch boss encounter in both the Pilgrimage and A Short Adventure, you've already been on the receiving end of a few of the Bard's abilities. [In the business, we call this foreshadowing.]

It should be noted that not every character has the same skills even if they share the same class. Other factors, such as background, may play a role in determining the skills they have available.

A few other notes: The inns are the general place to rest up and cook any food you've gathered, but this can also be done in a party member's home. As with the party members in Pilgrimage, Citra will open up her home for cooking and lodging for the party.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_b9422a9b383996c3a0b573fe74484a220a48ff0e.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696019716[/img]

While I do have a general idea where I would like to take things, I am amenable to reviewing feedback and making adjustments, when possible. 

Considering it's nearing Halloween and it's also the year of the Rabbit, I decided to give Citra a costume as well. It's a bunny outfit that she's used as a distraction a time or two. Her spare set of clothes can be found in a chest within the basement of her estate and can be used to swap back and forth between outfits.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_66e983cf979b9112e66d67a96b194c12ed24ecd2.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696019716[/img]

While we're on the subject, there's plenty of ways to enjoy the upcoming fall festivities. Even if you're playing for free, you can enjoy a Halloween themed Harvest Festival by interacting with the Jack-o-lantern at the Oakside Inn. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384140/ss_cffb53797972cc62c8a7b9c85f94baab7b1515fa.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696017434[/img]

Players with the add-on DLC for A Short Adventure will be can find a fanatical mage wandering around Oakside. To which, the party may choose to engage him in combat. The fight can be a little challenging but it shouldn't be any trouble if you're high enough level and figure out his weakness. The rewards for defeating him are substantial.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384221/ss_b025f37a80f09c4442adb3b5fad03a4f10eef10b.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696019716[/img]

Players with  Luminous Skies: The Pilgrimage will be able to find a Jack-o-lantern inside the Imperial Capitol Inn. Not only does the Imperial Capitol get new decorations but there may be a special encounter that may appear as a result. Inquiring with the local citizens may shed some light on this darkened path.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2384222/ss_0f0488fe60492434a2ab34c321a45c1f1dd377a9.1920x1080.jpg?t=1696276829[/img]
